values: Fictional test data. BLACK PEARL. Hamina (FIHMN), departure 11.11.2026, voyage EX-CGD-001.
Fictional NEMOLink test. Load cargo at FIHMN. C2 is transit cargo. C3 was loaded at SESTO and remains on board. G4 is an empty container.
Ports: FIHMN Hamina, SESTO Stockholm, DEHAM Hamburg, NLRTM Rotterdam. Each consignment has one loading and discharge port pair.
C2 is separate because its transport document marks it as transit. C3 keeps its original loading port because the cargo stays on board.
The vessel, people, references, registrations and cargo movements are test data. Replace vessel and port-call details to match your test call.
Gross mass includes packaging. Blank fields on G4 are intentional. Package quantity is filled only for the five cars carried for sale.
Birch plywood, each ply 6 mm or less
Sawn pine timber, thickness over 6 mm
Hot-rolled steel plate, over 10 mm thick
Five petrol passenger cars, 2.0 L, for sale
Common wheat, not seed, in bulk
One row per equipment unit. G2 uses two trucks of the same type. G1 and G8 have the same HS code but different equipment and stay separate.
G4 tests empty equipment: HS code, gross mass and goods description are blank. Its container category, size and identifier are filled.
G7 tests vehicles for sale: VN with quantity 5 and gross mass 7,500 kg. Passenger-accompanied private cars are excluded.
G9 tests bulk cargo: AI and hold identifier 1. Packaging and package quantity are blank. VD is not used in this CGD example.
G2 gross mass is 5,000 kg combined across XYZ123 and CCC222. It must be counted once when joining goods to equipment.
Container identifiers have valid ISO 6346 check digits. The NMLU prefix is fictional and has not been checked as a registered owner code.
HS codes, package codes and container sizes were cross-checked against NEMOLink reference lists. BPO follows the current EMSWe CGD guide.
Editable goods and equipment rows are the source data. The first-sheet cargo rows and mass totals link to these details.
